title: TD613 Sequence 5.5 Receiver Output Schema
description: Per-receiver model response schema for Sequence 5.5 evaluating a single test fixture under assigned treatment.

finding_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation finding, e.g. FINDING-PILOT-01 or FINDING-BAT-01.

identified_issues.description: List of specific architectural, epistemic, or governance defects identified.

evidence.description: Specific evidence points citing the observed telemetry, logs, or system behavior.

recommended_action.description: Recommended remedial, investigative, or governance action.

confidence.description: Receiver confidence rating in the verdict.
